title: Transverse measure σ on V^⊥ with ν(p⁻¹A ∩ q⁻¹B) = σ(B)·Hⁿ(A ∩ V) for a locally finite V-invariant measure ν
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let V ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace with dim V = n, let p := V.starProjection and q := V^⊥.starProjection be the orthogonal projections of ℝ^P onto V and onto V^⊥, and let ν be a Borel measure on ℝ^P with ν(K) < ∞ for every compact K and ν({x : v + x ∈ A}) = ν(A) for every v ∈ V and every Borel A. Then there is a Borel measure σ on ℝ^P with σ(ℝ^P ∖ V^⊥) = 0, σ(K) < ∞ for every compact K, and ν({y : p y ∈ A, q y ∈ B}) = σ(B)·Hⁿ(A ∩ V) for all Borel A, B ⊆ ℝ^P (Hⁿ = μHE[n]).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ V = n → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν K < ∞) → (∀ v ∈ V, ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν ((fun x => v + x) ⁻¹' A) = ν A) → ∃ σ : Measure (Euclid P), σ (Vᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → σ K < ∞) ∧ ∀ A B : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → ν (V.starProjection ⁻¹' A ∩ Vᗮ.starProjection ⁻¹' B) = σ B * μHE[n] (A ∩ (V : Set (Euclid P)))
